# Diseases

This folder groups specific pathological diseases and chronic conditions that complicate or co-occur with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) within the Danish healthcare system. It is divided into primary gastrointestinal diseases and severe complications, such as colorectal cancer, alongside distinct IBD comorbidities like primary sclerosing cholangitis. Together, these sub-folders document the conditions that drive mandatory surveillance colonoscopies and national quality indicators tracked by the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD).

## Pages

- [[entities/diseases/gastrointestinal/index|Gastrointestinal]] — Specific gastrointestinal diseases and severe complications arising in IBD patients, currently focusing on colorectal cancer and its mandated surveillance strategies.
- [[entities/diseases/ibd-comorbidities/index|Ibd Comorbidities]] — Chronic medical conditions acting as comorbidities to IBD, such as primary sclerosing cholangitis, which elevate cancer risks and require rigorous national quality monitoring.
